visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit supermarket aisle featuring an expansive tiered display of peaches. Each individual peach is cradled in a protective mesh foam wrapper, mostly in light green and white hues, arranged neatly on dark trays. A large pink sign with Japanese text hangs above the display, and the creator's brand logo is visible at the bottom. (2) A hand with fair skin enters the frame, lifting a clear plastic pack containing two large, ripe peaches. The packaging features a gold and black logo with a crown and Japanese text for a specific variety. The background shows the blurred supermarket environment with refrigerated cases and shoppers moving in the distance. (3) The camera pans to cardboard boxes on a display table, each filled with several large peaches nestled in white foam. A small white price card indicates a price of 1000 yen. The indoor lighting is bright and even, highlighting the vibrant pink and yellow colors of the fruit. (4) A close-up shot shows a single large, fuzzy peach in an individual clear plastic container, priced at 880 yen. A hand holds the container to emphasize its size and quality against the background of more fruit displays and supermarket signage. (5) The camera tilts up to reveal an informational poster titled '旬の果物' (Seasonal Fruit), which features a multi-colored quadrant chart and photos of different peach varieties like 'Hakuho'. The display continues below with more neatly packaged peaches on the shelves.
